'''Kayala Fei''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[44 ABY]] disguised as an announcer at the [[BAMR News]] that advised the citizens of the plot of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] spice cartel. She was killed by [[Octa Ramis]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|the Jedi attack]].
